blocks.text: NEW YORK — Karl-Anthony Towns had 30 points and 13 rebounds, Jalen Brunson added 22 points, and the New York Knicks beat the Indiana Pacers 113-106 on Sunday night to extend their winning streak to five games. Towns, who missed Saturday night’s buzzer-beater victory over Portland due to an illness, shot 9 for 14 from the field including 4 for 4 on 3-pointers. Landry Shamet scored 17 points while Josh Hart finished with 10 points, 11 assists and 10 rebounds for the Knicks.
